title: Septic Service Form
subtitle: Residential Septic Service: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Septic Service Form covers tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area. The septic service coordinator records Residential Septic Service activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Septic Service Form keeps Residential Septic Service exceptions visible until the septic service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Septic Service Form at property, tank access, pump chamber, distribution area, and protected ground surface. Document tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area identity before Residential Septic Service begins. Compare tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area findings with stated Residential Septic Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Septic Service issues to qualified septic-system reviewer. For Septic Service Form, confirm requirements for Residential Septic Service. Ask qualified septic-system reviewer to review Residential Septic Service conditions beyond the septic service coordinator's role.

blocks.label: Residential Septic Service operating checks
items: Access cover, riser, seal, and surface condition
Liquid level, scum, sludge, inlet, outlet, and baffle observation
Pump, float, alarm, control, and electrical indication
Backup, odor, surfacing effluent, and wet-area evidence
Vehicle, excavation, fall, biological, and confined-space boundary
Post-service level, closure, alarm, and flow observation
blocks.guidance: Complete the Residential Septic Service checks that apply to this tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area activity; explain every unchecked required item.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when access safety, containment, backup, structural integrity, disposal, or qualified escalation remains unresolved. Protect tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area; document the Residential Septic Service notification and await qualified septic-system reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Stop, hold, or correction triggers
items: Unsafe opening, fall, biological, or confined-space exposure
Backup or surfacing effluent threatens occupancy
Damaged tank or component requires excavation
Electrical, structural, or regulatory work outside scope
blocks.guidance: For Residential Septic Service, identify affected tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area scope; ask septic service coordinator to document the Residential Septic Service immediate control before continuing.
